clientComments.topic: Page load takes a couple of seconds
decisiveEvidence: The prior local small-fixture p95 first-interactive observation was about 4.9 seconds
e2e/estimate-loading-performance.spec.ts fails before collection because it imports a CLI module containing import.meta.main
buildEstimateLoadingArtifact validates completeness and correlation but does not compare results with numeric budgets
The authenticated route-transition smoke currently permits 10 seconds, while the bundle checker applies one 350 KB route threshold and does not enforce the roadmap total-JS gate
.ai/01_roadmap/27-performance-budget-and-regression-gates.md now supplies canonical closed-beta normal and representative hard-refresh p95 gates plus a single-sample max-stall ceiling
clientComments.remainingWork: Repair the import boundary; bind authenticated run-scoped D1 fixtures to completed Next production and OpenNext builds; replace loose transition/bundle thresholds with digest-bound canonical assertions; enforce hard-refresh, row-interaction, route, and bundle gates; capture a retained red baseline; optimize measured contributors; and prove both runtimes.
